protocol.holdout: random observation holdout, 70/30, shared across models
protocol.full_field: synthetic truth at one history slot; not used to fit the model
protocol.note: Interval coverage is empirical. Tree std and IDW delta-method std are not claimed to be calibrated posteriors.

metric_definitions.mae_causal: Mean absolute error of IDW predictions at each evaluation slot, using only observations with slot <= t, against the clean synthetic field.
metric_definitions.rmse_causal: Root mean squared error under the same causal protocol.
metric_definitions.coverage: Fraction of grids with at least one successful sample during the evaluation horizon.
metric_definitions.sampling_cost: Sum of participant costs of successful samples. Rejected or missed tasks are refunded when replanning is enabled.
metric_definitions.interval_coverage: Empirical frequency with which truth falls inside mean ± 1.96 predictive std. This checks the uncertainty, it does not prove calibration.
